senses.en: to play music to support a singer or another player
senses.pattern: accompany a singer on the piano / be accompanied by a guitar / accompany the choir
senses.example: Her younger brother will [[accompany]] her on the guitar when she sings at the talent show.
senses.example_zh: 她在才藝表演上唱歌時，弟弟會用吉他為她伴奏。

senses.en: to happen or appear together with something else
senses.pattern: be accompanied by fever / be accompanied by thunder / strong winds accompanied by rain
senses.example: The typhoon's strong winds were [[accompanied]] by heavy rain that flooded several streets downtown.
senses.example_zh: 颱風的強風伴隨著豪雨，淹沒了市中心好幾條街道。
senses.note: 常用被動 be accompanied by

gsat.sentence: Most of the performance was not [[accompanied]] by any instrument.
Moreover, the effect is often [[accompanied]] by space motion sickness, headaches, and nausea.

senses.en: to take on a duty, power, or position
senses.pattern: assume responsibility / assume office / assume control / assume the role of
senses.example: When the captain was injured, Mia [[assumed]] responsibility for leading the team through the final match.
senses.example_zh: 隊長受傷後，米亞承擔起帶領球隊打完最後一場比賽的責任。

senses.en: to begin to have a quality, or to pretend to
senses.pattern: assume an air of confidence / assume a new importance / assume the form of
senses.example: Although he was terrified, Leo [[assumed]] an air of calm and walked onto the stage.
senses.example_zh: 雖然心裡害怕，里歐還是裝出鎮定的樣子走上舞台。

senses.en: to officially give someone a prize or honor
senses.pattern: award sb a prize / be awarded a medal / be awarded a scholarship
senses.example: The committee [[awarded]] her a full scholarship for her outstanding research on ocean pollution.
senses.example_zh: 委員會因她在海洋污染方面的傑出研究而授予她全額獎學金。

senses.en: to decide officially that someone should receive money
senses.pattern: award damages / award compensation / be awarded two million dollars
senses.example: The court [[awarded]] the injured worker two million dollars in damages after a long trial.
senses.example_zh: 經過漫長的審理，法院判給受傷的工人兩百萬美元賠償金。

gsat.sentence: The 2011 Nobel Peace Prize was [[awarded]] jointly to three women for the efforts they made in fighting for women’s rights.
Two years later, it was [[awarded]] first prize again at Houston’s first annual Invention Fair.

senses.en: difficult to deal with; causing problems
senses.pattern: an awkward job / an awkward question / an awkward customer
senses.example: Fixing the leak was an [[awkward]] job because the pipe was hidden behind the kitchen wall.
senses.example_zh: 修理漏水是件棘手的工作，因為水管藏在廚房的牆後面。

senses.en: not convenient; difficult to use or carry
senses.pattern: an awkward time / awkward to carry / an awkward shape
senses.example: Seven in the morning is an [[awkward]] time for a meeting, since most parents are taking children to school.
senses.example_zh: 早上七點開會是個不方便的時間，因為大多數家長正在送孩子上學。

gsat.sentence: The French were also slow to accept forks, for using them was thought to be [[awkward]].

senses.en: only just; succeeding, but with great difficulty
senses.pattern: barely pass the test / barely survive / barely escape / barely make it
senses.example: Our team [[barely]] won the final, scoring the winning goal in the very last minute.
senses.example_zh: 我們隊在最後一分鐘才踢進致勝球，勉強贏得決賽。
senses.note: 表示「勉強做到」，結果是肯定的

senses.en: only a very short time before; no more than
senses.pattern: had barely arrived when / barely a week later / barely 18 years old
senses.example: She had [[barely]] sat down at her desk when the fire alarm started to ring.
senses.example_zh: 她才剛在書桌前坐下，火災警報器就響了起來。

senses.en: money or extras given by an employer or the government
senses.pattern: unemployment benefits / employee benefits / claim benefits
senses.example: Workers who lose their jobs can apply for unemployment [[benefits]] while they look for new positions.
senses.example_zh: 失業的勞工在找新工作期間可以申請失業補助金。

senses.en: an event held to raise money for charity
senses.pattern: a benefit concert / a benefit dinner / hold a benefit for
senses.example: Local musicians held a [[benefit]] last weekend to raise money for families who lost their homes in the flood.
senses.example_zh: 當地音樂人上週末舉辦義演，為在水災中失去家園的家庭募款。

gsat.sentence: “What started out as an extra one-day-a-week [[benefit]] for employees has really become an everyday thing,” said business consultant Maisly Jones.

senses.en: to have something impressive that one can be proud of
senses.pattern: boast a long history / boast beautiful beaches / boast a fine collection
senses.example: With over three hundred sunny days a year, the coastal city [[boasts]] the best weather in the country.
senses.example_zh: 這座濱海城市一年有三百多天放晴，擁有全國最好的天氣。
senses.note: 主詞多為地方或事物，不用被動

gsat.sentence: Aside from handcrafted beer, the menu [[boasts]] hand-made gourmet pizzas such as the Yummy Duck n’ Cheese, loaded with roast duck and, yes, creamy delicious cheese.

senses.en: the number of copies a newspaper or magazine sells
senses.pattern: a daily circulation of / a wide circulation / circulation figures
senses.example: The local newspaper has a daily [[circulation]] of fifty thousand, mostly among older readers.
senses.example_zh: 這家地方報紙的每日發行量為五萬份，讀者大多是年長者。

senses.en: the passing of money or goods from person to person
senses.pattern: in circulation / out of circulation / put into circulation
senses.example: The old paper notes were taken out of [[circulation]] and replaced with plastic ones.
senses.example_zh: 舊的紙鈔已停止流通，改由塑膠鈔票取代。

senses.en: a group of animals or plants living together
senses.pattern: a colony of ants / a bee colony / a penguin colony / form a colony
senses.example: A single [[colony]] of bees can contain more than fifty thousand workers during the summer.
senses.example_zh: 夏季時，光是一個蜜蜂群體就可能有五萬多隻工蜂。

gsat.sentence: The trails connect the ants’ [[colonies]] and sources of food, forming a sort of communication network.
Small birds such as baby quails are fair game to the expanding [[colony]].

senses.en: a tall stone post, or something with that shape
senses.pattern: marble columns / stone columns / a column of smoke
senses.example: Thick white [[columns]] hold up the roof of the old temple at the top of the hill.
senses.example_zh: 粗大的白色圓柱支撐著山頂那座古老神殿的屋頂。

senses.en: a vertical section of a table or page
senses.pattern: the left-hand column / a column of figures / rows and columns
senses.example: Write each student's name in the first [[column]] of the table and the score in the second.
senses.example_zh: 把每位學生的名字寫在表格的第一個直欄，分數寫在第二欄。

gsat.sentence: The oldest spiral staircase still standing today is at Trajan’s [[Column]] in Rome.
The trunk of redwood trees is very stout and usually forms a single straight [[column]].

senses.en: a subject of study, especially at a university
senses.pattern: an academic discipline / a scientific discipline / across disciplines
senses.example: Psychology is a relatively young [[discipline]] compared with mathematics or philosophy.
senses.example_zh: 與數學或哲學相比，心理學是一門相對年輕的學科。

senses.en: to punish or train someone to obey rules
senses.pattern: be disciplined for / discipline a student / discipline one's children
senses.example: Two players were [[disciplined]] by the coach for skipping practice without permission.
senses.example_zh: 兩名球員因未經許可缺席練習而遭教練懲戒。

senses.en: (of a change) sudden, very great, and noticeable
senses.pattern: a dramatic increase / a dramatic change / a dramatic drop / a dramatic improvement
senses.example: The past decade has seen a [[dramatic]] increase in the number of people working from home.
senses.example_zh: 過去十年間，在家工作的人數急遽增加。

senses.zh: 驚險刺激的；引人注目的
senses.en: exciting and impressive
senses.pattern: a dramatic rescue / a dramatic finish / dramatic scenery
senses.example: Firefighters carried out a [[dramatic]] rescue, pulling the driver out seconds before the car caught fire.
senses.example_zh: 消防員上演了一場驚險刺激的救援，在車子起火前幾秒把駕駛拉了出來。

gsat.sentence: For some people, even a five-minute nap can bring about surprisingly [[dramatic]] benefits.
But the growth of public television in the past two decades has been [[dramatic]].

senses.en: to show a quality, feeling, or sign clearly
senses.pattern: exhibit symptoms / exhibit signs of stress / exhibit a trait / exhibit behavior
senses.example: Children who grow up with pets often [[exhibit]] greater kindness toward animals later in life.
senses.example_zh: 從小與寵物一起長大的孩子，日後往往對動物表現出更多的善意。

senses.en: an object shown to the public in a museum
senses.pattern: a museum exhibit / the exhibits on display / an interactive exhibit
senses.example: Visitors are asked not to touch the [[exhibits]], some of which are over two thousand years old.
senses.example_zh: 參觀者請勿觸摸展品，其中有些已有兩千多年的歷史。

gsat.sentence: If neither of the parents has dimple genes, their children will not [[exhibit]] the trait.
It must be free from impurity, while [[exhibiting]] some fruitiness and creating a pleasant bitter flavor along with a peppery sensation in the mouth.

senses.en: to want or like something
senses.pattern: fancy a drink / fancy a walk / fancy doing something
senses.example: Do you [[fancy]] a cup of tea, or would you rather have some juice?
senses.example_zh: 你想要喝杯茶，還是比較想喝點果汁？

senses.en: a sudden liking; something imagined, not real
senses.pattern: take a fancy to / a passing fancy / catch somebody's fancy
senses.example: The children took a [[fancy]] to the stray puppy and begged their parents to keep it.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們一下子就喜愛上那隻流浪小狗，央求父母把牠留下來。

senses.en: to succeed or get along in a stated way
senses.pattern: fare well / fare badly / fare better than
senses.example: Students who review their notes every day usually [[fare]] better on exams than those who cram.
senses.example_zh: 每天複習筆記的學生，考試表現通常比臨時抱佛腳的人好。

senses.en: the kind of food served at a place
senses.pattern: traditional fare / simple fare / local fare / vegetarian fare
senses.example: The night market is famous for its traditional [[fare]], such as oyster omelets and stinky tofu.
senses.example_zh: 這個夜市以蚵仔煎、臭豆腐等傳統食物聞名。

gsat.sentence: Initially Velcro did not [[fare]] well.

senses.en: to be sold for a particular amount of money
senses.pattern: fetch a high price / fetch a good price / fetch $500 at auction
senses.example: Because so few were ever made, the old comic book [[fetched]] a surprisingly high price online.
senses.example_zh: 由於當年印量極少，這本舊漫畫在網路上賣得了出乎意料的高價。

senses.en: a device in a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound
senses.pattern: sound the horn / honk the horn / a car horn
senses.example: The taxi driver sounded his [[horn]] angrily when a scooter suddenly cut in front of him.
senses.example_zh: 一輛機車突然切到前面時，計程車司機氣得猛按喇叭。

senses.en: a brass musical instrument that you blow into
senses.pattern: play the horn / a French horn / blow a horn
senses.example: My cousin plays the French [[horn]] in the school orchestra and practices every evening.
senses.example_zh: 我表哥在學校管弦樂團吹法國號，每天晚上都會練習。

senses.en: nearest in time, space, or relationship
senses.pattern: immediate family / the immediate future / the immediate neighborhood / immediate surroundings
senses.example: Only [[immediate]] family members, such as parents and children, were allowed to visit the patient.
senses.example_zh: 只有父母、子女等關係最親的家屬才獲准探視病人。
senses.note: immediate family＝至親（父母、配偶、子女等）

senses.en: existing now and needing urgent attention
senses.pattern: an immediate threat / immediate concern / immediate needs / in no immediate danger
senses.example: Our [[immediate]] concern is finding shelter for the victims; rebuilding the town can wait.
senses.example_zh: 我們當前最迫切的考量是為災民找到棲身之處；重建城鎮可以晚一點再說。

gsat.sentence: A newly published study, however, revealed that rising temperatures are posing an [[immediate]] threat to the last tropical glaciers in Indonesia’s Papua region.
So the stunt industry is probably in no [[immediate]] danger of dying off.

senses.en: importance or significance (formal)
senses.pattern: a matter of great import / of little import / of no import
senses.example: The committee met to discuss matters of great [[import]] to the future of the school.
senses.example_zh: 委員會開會討論對學校未來極具重要性的事務。
senses.note: 正式用語；重音在第一音節

senses.en: the meaning of something, especially when not stated directly
senses.pattern: the full import of / grasp the import of / the import of his words
senses.example: It took him several days to grasp the full [[import]] of what the doctor had said.
senses.example_zh: 他花了好幾天才領會醫生那番話的全部含意。

senses.en: to influence or shape an idea, decision, or work
senses.pattern: inform a decision / inform policy / be informed by
senses.example: Her years of volunteering in a hospital clearly [[inform]] the way she writes about illness.
senses.example_zh: 她多年在醫院擔任志工的經歷，明顯影響了她書寫疾病的方式。
senses.note: informed (adj.) 有見識的、有根據的

senses.en: to give the police information about someone's wrongdoing
senses.pattern: inform on sb / inform against sb / inform on one's friends
senses.example: One gang member [[informed]] on the others, and the police arrested them all within days.
senses.example_zh: 一名幫派成員告發了其他人，警方幾天內就將他們全數逮捕。

senses.en: to make up something that is not true
senses.pattern: invent an excuse / invent a story / invent a reason
senses.example: Afraid of being scolded, the boy [[invented]] a story about a traffic jam to explain his lateness.
senses.example_zh: 男孩怕挨罵，便捏造了塞車的說法來解釋自己為何遲到。

senses.en: one of a regular series of magazines or newspapers
senses.pattern: the latest issue / the current issue / a back issue / a special issue
senses.example: The latest [[issue]] of the science magazine has a ten-page special report on black holes.
senses.example_zh: 這本科學雜誌的最新一期有長達十頁的黑洞專題報導。

senses.en: to officially announce something or give something out
senses.pattern: issue a warning / issue a statement / issue a passport / issue a visa
senses.example: The weather bureau [[issued]] a heavy rain warning for the mountain areas this afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 氣象局今天下午對山區發布了豪雨特報。

gsat.sentence: The latest [[issue]] of a magazine.

In medieval Europe, on the other hand, travel documents were [[issued]] by local authorities, and generally contained a list of towns and cities which the document holder was permitted to enter or pass through.

senses.en: to describe or name someone or something in a particular way
senses.pattern: label sb (as) a troublemaker / be labeled lazy / be labeled as a failure
senses.example: Students who ask many questions should not be [[labeled]] as troublemakers by their teachers.
senses.example_zh: 愛發問的學生不該被老師歸類為麻煩製造者。
senses.note: 多用被動，常帶負面意味

senses.en: a company that makes fashion goods; its brand name
senses.pattern: a designer label / a fashion label / her own label / a luxury label
senses.example: After years of designing for others, she launched her own fashion [[label]] in Paris.
senses.example_zh: 替別人設計多年後，她在巴黎創立了自己的時裝品牌。

gsat.sentence: For example, the 14th typhoon in 2003 can be [[labeled]] either as Typhoon 0314 or Typhoon 200314.

senses.en: having a lot of knowledge gained from study
senses.pattern: a learned scholar / a learned professor / a learned journal
senses.example: The museum invited a [[learned]] monk to explain the meaning of the old temple paintings to visitors.
senses.example_zh: 博物館請了一位博學的僧人，為遊客解說古老廟宇壁畫的含意。

senses.en: gained through experience or training, not inborn
senses.pattern: learned behavior / a learned response / learned skills
senses.example: Scientists believe that a fear of snakes is partly a [[learned]] response rather than something we are born with.
senses.example_zh: 科學家認為，對蛇的恐懼有一部分是後天習得的反應，而非與生俱來。

gsat.sentence: For students cramming for college exams, napping will help retain acquired knowledge and [[learned]] skills.

senses.en: a group of baby animals born at one time
senses.pattern: a litter of puppies / a litter of kittens / the smallest of the litter
senses.example: Our neighbor's dog gave birth to a [[litter]] of six puppies last night.
senses.example_zh: 我們鄰居的狗昨晚生了一窩六隻小狗。

senses.en: to be scattered over a place; (passive) to be full of
senses.pattern: be littered with mistakes / be littered with examples / litter the floor
senses.example: His essay was [[littered]] with spelling mistakes, so the teacher asked him to write it again.
senses.example_zh: 他的作文充斥著拼字錯誤，所以老師要他重寫。
senses.note: 多用被動 be littered with

gsat.sentence: Soon after their conversation, the guru died and the sow did have a [[litter]] of four little pigs.
I’m going to be the fourth piglet of its next [[litter]].

senses.en: how high or low a sound or voice is
senses.pattern: a high pitch / rise in pitch / perfect pitch / the pitch of a note
senses.example: Her voice rose in [[pitch]] as she grew more and more excited about the news.
senses.example_zh: 她對這個消息越來越興奮，聲音的音調也跟著升高。
senses.note: 英式英語另指「（足球）球場」

senses.en: to set up a tent or a camp
senses.pattern: pitch a tent / pitch camp / pitch a tent by the river
senses.example: We [[pitched]] our tent beside the lake just before the sun went down.
senses.example_zh: 我們趕在太陽下山前，在湖邊搭起了帳篷。

gsat.sentence: On October 27, 1915, Shackleton ordered his crew to abandon the ship, [[pitching]] tents on the ice a mile and a half away.
He had a glassmaker create thirty-seven hemispheres made of glass, with each being a different size and thickness to produce different [[pitches]].

senses.en: easily shaped or changed
senses.pattern: highly plastic / remain plastic / a plastic material
senses.example: Young children's brains are highly [[plastic]], which is why they pick up new languages so easily.
senses.example_zh: 幼兒的大腦可塑性極高，這就是他們學新語言學得這麼輕鬆的原因。
senses.note: 名詞 plasticity；plastic surgery 整形手術

senses.en: seeming artificial; not real or sincere
senses.pattern: a plastic smile / look plastic / sound plastic
senses.example: The host greeted every guest with the same [[plastic]] smile and then quickly looked away.
senses.example_zh: 主持人用同樣虛假的笑容迎接每位來賓，隨即把目光移開。

senses.en: to tell a customer the price you will charge
senses.pattern: quote a price / quote sb a price / quote sb $500 for
senses.example: The mechanic [[quoted]] us eight thousand dollars for repairing the engine, which seemed far too high.
senses.example_zh: 修車師傅向我們報價八千元修理引擎，這似乎貴得離譜。

senses.en: a statement of how much a job will cost
senses.pattern: get a quote / ask for a quote / a free quote
senses.example: Before choosing a moving company, we asked three of them for a written [[quote]].
senses.example_zh: 選定搬家公司之前，我們請其中三家提供書面報價。

senses.zh: 未經加工的；未經處理的
senses.en: in a natural state, not yet processed or analyzed
senses.pattern: raw materials / raw data / raw footage
senses.example: The scientists spent months turning the [[raw]] data from the survey into charts that the public could understand.
senses.example_zh: 科學家花了好幾個月，把問卷調查中未經處理的數據整理成大眾看得懂的圖表。

senses.en: (of skin) red and painful from rubbing or cold
senses.pattern: be rubbed raw / red and raw / raw skin
senses.example: After an hour of rowing without gloves, her hands were [[raw]] and too sore to hold a pen.
senses.example_zh: 沒戴手套划了一小時的船後，她的雙手破皮刺痛，痛得連筆都握不住。

senses.en: to accept that something is true, legal, or important
senses.pattern: recognize that … / recognize the need for / be officially recognized / recognize sb's right
senses.example: The company finally [[recognized]] that its long working hours were harming employees' health.
senses.example_zh: 該公司終於承認，過長的工時正在損害員工的健康。

senses.en: to officially praise or reward someone's achievement
senses.pattern: be recognized for / recognize sb's contribution / recognize outstanding service
senses.example: At the ceremony, three nurses were [[recognized]] for their brave service during the flood.
senses.example_zh: 典禮上，三位護理師因在水災期間的英勇服務而受到表揚。

gsat.sentence: It was officially [[recognized]] in Brazil through the effort of Mestre Bimba.
“It is great to see leaders in the fashion industry [[recognizing]] that the animals need their fur more than we do.”

senses.en: to make yourself accept something unpleasant that cannot be changed
senses.pattern: resign oneself to sth / resign oneself to doing sth / be resigned to sth
senses.example: Knowing the injury would take months to heal, the runner [[resigned]] herself to missing the whole season.
senses.example_zh: 那位跑者知道傷勢要好幾個月才會痊癒，只好無奈接受整季缺賽的事實。
senses.note: to 為介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing

senses.en: one of the small thin plates covering a fish or reptile
senses.pattern: fish scales / be covered in scales / scrape off the scales
senses.example: Before cooking the fish, Grandpa scraped off its [[scales]] with the back of a knife.
senses.example_zh: 煮魚之前，爺爺用刀背刮掉魚的鱗片。

senses.en: a device for weighing people or things
senses.pattern: a bathroom scale / kitchen scales / step on the scale / weigh sth on a scale
senses.example: The nurse asked me to step on the [[scale]] so that she could record my weight.
senses.example_zh: 護理師請我站上磅秤，好讓她記錄我的體重。

senses.en: to climb to the top of something high
senses.pattern: scale a wall / scale a cliff / scale a mountain / scale new heights
senses.example: Using only ropes and their bare hands, the climbers [[scaled]] the cliff in under three hours.
senses.example_zh: 登山者只靠繩索和雙手，不到三小時就攀登上那座峭壁。

senses.en: large enough to be noticed or have an effect
senses.pattern: a significant increase / a significant amount of / a significant difference / a significant number of
senses.example: The survey found a [[significant]] drop in the number of teenagers who read newspapers.
senses.example_zh: 調查發現，閱讀報紙的青少年人數有顯著的下降。

senses.en: having a special or hidden meaning
senses.pattern: a significant look / a significant glance / a significant smile / a significant pause
senses.example: When I mentioned the surprise party, Mom gave Dad a [[significant]] look and quickly changed the subject.
senses.example_zh: 我一提到驚喜派對，媽媽就意味深長地看了爸爸一眼，隨即轉移話題。

gsat.sentence: The secret is: Never wait until the body is telling you you’re thirsty, since there must already have been [[significant]] changes in your body for it to eventually alert your consciousness.
There is, however, a [[significant]] gap between such beliefs and the actual effect of weather on people’s performance at work.

senses.en: interest or excitement added to something
senses.pattern: add spice to / the spice of life / give spice to
senses.example: Traveling to unfamiliar places adds [[spice]] to a life that might otherwise feel boring.
senses.example_zh: 到陌生的地方旅行，能為原本可能乏味的生活增添趣味。

senses.en: to make something more interesting or exciting
senses.pattern: spice up a speech / spice up one's life / spice things up
senses.example: The teacher [[spiced]] up her history lessons with funny stories about ancient kings.
senses.example_zh: 老師用古代國王的趣聞，使她的歷史課更有趣味。

senses.en: to make thread, or (of a spider) a web
senses.pattern: spin a web / spin thread / spin wool into yarn
senses.example: The spider [[spun]] a new web between the two branches overnight to catch flying insects.
senses.example_zh: 那隻蜘蛛一夜之間就在兩根樹枝間結了一張新網來捕捉飛蟲。

senses.en: a way of presenting information to influence opinion
senses.pattern: put a positive spin on / put a new spin on / a different spin
senses.example: The coach tried to put a positive [[spin]] on the loss by praising the team's effort.
senses.example_zh: 教練稱讚球隊的努力，試圖為這場敗仗找個正面的說法。
senses.note: 常用 put a … spin on

senses.en: to be caused by or develop from something
senses.pattern: stem from sth / stem from a lack of sth / stem largely from sth
senses.example: Many of his health problems [[stem]] from years of poor sleep and too little exercise.
senses.example_zh: 他的許多健康問題都源自多年的睡眠不足和缺乏運動。
senses.note: 恆與 from 連用，不用進行式

senses.en: to stop something from spreading or increasing
senses.pattern: stem the spread of sth / stem the flow of sth / stem the tide of sth
senses.example: The government closed schools for two weeks to [[stem]] the spread of the virus.
senses.example_zh: 政府停課兩週，以遏止病毒擴散。

gsat.sentence: Some see it as a celebration related to the turn of the seasons from winter to spring; others, however, believe that it [[stems]] from the adoption of a new calendar.
The absence of smiles [[stemmed]] partly from the attempt to hide their decayed teeth caused by poor dental hygiene.

senses.en: a good quality or ability that someone has
senses.pattern: strengths and weaknesses / one's greatest strength / play to one's strengths
senses.example: One of Jenny's greatest [[strengths]] as a team leader is her ability to listen patiently.
senses.example_zh: 珍妮身為組長最大的優點之一，就是能耐心傾聽。

gsat.sentence: Different dogs display [[strengths]] in different intelligences.
The moral lesson is “First identify your [[strengths]], and then change the playing field to suit them.”

senses.en: to take something away from someone or something
senses.pattern: strip sb of a title / strip sb of power / strip a tree of its leaves / strip off the bark
senses.example: The runner was [[stripped]] of his gold medal after failing a drug test.
senses.example_zh: 這名跑者因藥檢未過，被剝奪了金牌。
senses.note: strip A of B：剝奪 A 的 B

senses.en: a long, narrow piece of land or water
senses.pattern: a strip of land / a narrow strip of beach / a coastal strip
senses.example: The farmers grow rice on a narrow [[strip]] of land between the mountains and the sea.
senses.example_zh: 農民在山與海之間的一塊狹長地帶種稻。

senses.en: a short series of cartoon drawings in a newspaper
senses.pattern: a comic strip / a newspaper strip / a cartoon strip
senses.example: My grandfather still cuts out his favorite comic [[strip]] from the newspaper every morning.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父至今每天早上仍會從報紙上剪下他最愛的連環漫畫。

gsat.sentence: They can quickly [[strip]] fruit trees of their fruit.
As a result, the astronauts have swollen, puffy faces, very much resembling that of the round-headed Charlie Brown in the famous comic [[strip]].

senses.en: the most important or essential part of something
senses.pattern: in substance / the substance of sth / lack substance / style over substance
senses.example: The two reports differ in style, but in [[substance]] they say exactly the same thing.
senses.example_zh: 這兩份報告風格不同，但就實質內容而言，說的完全是同一件事。

senses.en: the quality of being based on facts or truth
senses.pattern: without substance / no substance to sth / give substance to sth
senses.example: The school said there was no [[substance]] to the rumor that the trip had been canceled.
senses.example_zh: 校方表示，旅行已經取消的傳言毫無事實根據。

senses.en: an important meeting between leaders of governments
senses.pattern: a summit meeting / hold a summit / a climate summit / an economic summit
senses.example: Leaders from forty countries attended the [[summit]] to discuss how to slow global warming.
senses.example_zh: 四十國的領袖出席了這場高峰會，討論如何減緩全球暖化。

quiz.stem: Solving climate problems requires experts from many different ______, including chemistry, economics, and engineering, to work together.
quiz.explain_zh: discipline＝學科。解決氣候問題需要化學、經濟等不同學科的專家合作。

quiz.stem: Professor Chen is regarded as one of the most ______ scholars in her field, having read and written widely on ancient Asian history.
quiz.explain_zh: learned＝博學的。陳教授博覽群書、著作豐富，是該領域最博學的學者之一。

quiz.stem: My article on night markets will appear in the next ______ of the school magazine, which comes out at the end of this month.
quiz.explain_zh: issue＝（刊物的）一期。我的文章會刊登在月底出刊的下一期校刊上。

quiz.stem: Discovered in an old farmhouse last year, the painting is expected to ______ more than five million dollars at an auction next month.
quiz.explain_zh: fetch＝售得（價錢）。這幅畫預計在下個月的拍賣會上賣得五百多萬元。

quiz.stem: At the graduation ceremony, the music teacher ______ the school choir on the piano as they sang a farewell song to the seniors.
quiz.explain_zh: accompany＝為…伴奏。音樂老師彈鋼琴替合唱團伴奏。

quiz.stem: As more people read the news on their phones, the magazine's ______ has fallen from 80,000 copies a month to fewer than 20,000.
quiz.explain_zh: circulation＝發行量。大家改用手機看新聞，雜誌每月發行量大幅下滑。

quiz.stem: Zoo animals kept in small, empty cages may ______ unusual behaviors, such as walking in circles or biting their own tails.
quiz.explain_zh: exhibit＝表現出。關在狹小空籠裡的動物可能表現出繞圈等異常行為。

quiz.stem: After missing the last train, the two backpackers ______ themselves to sleeping on a bench at the station until morning.
quiz.explain_zh: resign＝使無奈接受。錯過末班車的背包客只好認命在車站長椅過夜。

quiz.stem: Volunteers piled up thousands of sandbags along the riverbank in an attempt to ______ the flow of muddy water into the town.
quiz.explain_zh: stem＝遏止。志工沿河岸堆沙包，設法阻擋泥水流入鎮上。

quiz.stem: Opened only last year, the city library ______ a rooftop garden, a 3D-printing lab, and more than half a million books.
quiz.explain_zh: boast＝擁有（值得自豪之物）。新圖書館有屋頂花園、3D 列印室和五十多萬冊藏書。
